rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for how often something occurs and for technical wave frequency.

example.english: The frequency of updates on this website is very high.
example.traditional: 呢個網站更新頻率好高。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 mong5 zaam6 gang1 san1 pan4 leot6 hou2 gou1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a frequency band or channel range in radio and wireless communications.

example.english: This radio can't receive that frequency band.
example.traditional: 呢部收音機收唔到嗰個頻段。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 sau1 jam1 gei1 sau1 m4 dou2 go2 go3 pan4 dyun6
